1.note: להטעים as printed; understood as 'to soften, explain away' the corporeal attributes.

2.note: The abbreviation מ"ע is unclear (perhaps a midrash collection or a misprint); kept as printed, ch. 4.

3.note: Abbreviation unclear as printed (perhaps a misprint); kept, ch. 16.

4.note: Serving God out of love is discussed at Sotah 31a (Mishnah 5:5); Sotah 24a as printed looks wrong.

5.note: The saying that sufferings are dearer than sacrifices is in Sifrei Va-etḥanan pisqa 32; 39 as printed looks wrong.

6.note: 2 Maccabees 12 has 45 verses; the offering for the dead is 12:43. Kept as printed.

7.note: The verse 'His eyes run to and fro through the whole earth' is 2 Chronicles 16:9; the print reads ט"ו.

8.note: The saying on Satan (goes down and leads astray, goes up and accuses) is Bava Batra 16a; the print reads ט"ו.

10.note: Read as Psalms of Solomon, as in the other references of this section.

11.note: 'Service of the heart' is in Sifre Ekev, sec. 41; the print has פ"א (81).

12.note: 'The Holy One longs for the prayer of the righteous' is Yevamot 64a; the print has צ"ד.

13.note: The first sign of the figure is unclear in the print; read as 636, probably a page of Mangey's edition of Philo.

14.note: Abbreviation unclear (perhaps Megillat Ta'anit or Midrash Tannaim); kept as printed.

15.note: 'More women, more sorcery' is Avot 2:7; reference kept as printed.

16.note: Print reads התחקה, probably for התחזקה; rendered 'held fast'.

17.note: The priest with Urim and Thummim is Ezra 2:63 (Nehemiah 7:65); kept as printed.

18.note: Read as הכנת ('establishing'); the sense may be 'restoration'.

19.note: ה or ח unclear in the print; Daniel 8:26 is the verse meant.

20.note: The vision of the one like a son of man is Daniel 7:13-14; kept as printed.

21.note: as printed; the verse on the spirit resting on him is Isaiah 42:1

22.note: as printed; Isaiah 53 has only 12 verses, perhaps 53:4, 9 or 12 is meant

23.note: print reads מ"ו (or מ"ז); the saying is Eduyot 8:7

24.note: print unclear (קיטו or קיצו); read as קטו, 'loathed'

25.note: first word unclear in print (יסודי/יסורי); book not identified

26.note: name unclear in print; read as De Wette
